residual_risks: Measured default greedy replay over 30 periods took 23.79 seconds on 500 deterministic history records; BMA took 0.585 seconds. Computation runs in a terminable Worker and the UI now explains the cost. Browser/device latency and the 200-period option were not measured.
Live browser interaction and mobile visual QA were blocked by host policy; component tests and production build cannot establish that visual acceptance.
